claims.head: Quinn gets company tonight
claims.call: The Capitals’ L2 (Protas, Jenner and Wilson) spends at least 45% of its 5-on-5 time against the Sabres’ first line, against about 30% with no line matching.
claims.body: At home, the Capitals keep sending Wilson’s line (Protas, Jenner and Wilson) out against opponents’ first lines, far more often than chance would suggest. Spencer Carbery has been giving this group the hard job of facing the other team’s top line. Tonight the Sabres’ first line is Benson, Östlund and Quinn.

claims.body: The Capitals are near the top of the league for depth, and the Sabres are near the bottom. It’s the widest gap between these two, though not a huge one.

items.text: Alex Tuch faces Buffalo for the first time since leaving.
The Capitals are newly without Logan Thompson, and have been without Rasmus Sandin for several games. Charlie Lindgren is expected to start.
The Sabres have been without Alex Lyon all season. Ukko-Pekka Luukkonen is expected to start.
Tom Wilson has seven goals in eight games against Buffalo since 2023-24.
